newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar shares keep to their firmer trend.
newsitem.headline: Qatar shares keep to their firmer trend.

text.p: Shares on Qatar's unofficial stock market kept to their firmer trend in the week to Thursday on expectations that the government would soon announce the opening of an official bourse, dealers said on Thursday.
Hussein Abdullah, recently appointed general manager of the Doha Securities Market, is expected to make an announcement about the new bourse at a news conference on Saturday, dealers said.
In the week to Thursday, the Commercial Bank of Qatar (CBQ) 18-share index edged up to 120.35 points from a previous 120.01.
CBQ senior investment manager Mazin al-Shakarchi said "the market took a breather after September's fast climb, yet many shares posted increases".
Seven shares rose by between one to five riyals and 10 were unchanged. One share -- Qatar Leisure -- shed a riyal.
Among the climbers were Doha Bank Ltd, which advanced two riyals to 268, the CBQ, which rose three riyals to 335, and Al Ahli Bank of Qatar, which gained two riyals to 210.
Qatar General Insurance rose five riyals to 525 and Qatar Navigation gained three riyals to 690.
Qatar Shipping gained one riyal to 48 and Qatar Cinema added two riyals to 175.
